name: Johan Danielsson - § 3
title: REPORT on addressing subcontracting chains and the role of intermediaries in order to protect workers’ rights
part_text: Recalls its resolution on social and employment aspects of restructuring processes, which calls on the Commission, in close cooperation with social partners, to consider establishing a framework directive to address the challenges and complexities associated with employers’ obligations in subcontracting chains and labour intermediaries in Europe to ensure decent working conditions and respect for workers’ rights, to include measures regulating the role of labour intermediaries, other than temporary work agencies, and to introduce an EU general legal framework limiting subcontracting and ensuring joint and several liability through the subcontracting chain;
